


/* -- TOP: the five canonical tabs ----------------------------------------
   Names and order are fixed for every page in the suite. Only entry 3's label
   and the five sub-labels change per demo. NO `stage` key: tab chips carry no
   stage number and no stage colour (§3.1). Glossary is reference material and
   is pushed to the right edge by its role. */
const TOP = [
  {label:"Data provenance", sub:"files, hashes and claims"},
  {label:"Design matrix",   sub:"one source × three features"},
  {label:"Membership probability", sub:"submitted trace and controlled models"},
  {label:"Conclusions",     sub:"evidence, failure and limits"},
  {label:"Glossary",        sub:"terms used here", role:"glossary-content"}
];

/* -- RIBBON: the pipeline diagram, with this demo's REAL numbers ----------
   One entry per PIPELINE STAGE — not per tab, and always starting at stage 1,
   preprocessing. There is no `tab` key: the diagram goes nowhere.
   Every `value` MUST be read out of D (the payload). A hard-coded number here
   is the thing this component exists to prevent. Keep `label` short — it is
   uppercase and clipped with an ellipsis on narrow screens. */
const RIBBON = [
  {stage:1, label:"Filter", value:D.metadata.n_clean.toLocaleString(), note:"quality-filtered Gaia rows"},
  {stage:2, label:"Transform", value:D.metadata.n_features + " features", note:"standardized motion and parallax"},
  {stage:3, label:"Cluster", value:Object.values(D.configurations).reduce((n,x)=>n+Object.keys(x).length,0) + " fits", note:"stored deterministic settings"},
  {stage:4, label:"Evaluate", value:D.configurations[D.controlled_initial.model][D.controlled_defaults[D.controlled_initial.model]].candidate_count.toLocaleString(), note:"default nearest-guide group"}
];

/* -- STORY: the three thumbnails of the story strip (§2.4) ----------------
   One painter per panel, in the strip's order — ① the data, ② the question,
   ③ the answer. Each is handed its own canvas plus the 2D context PC.fit() has
   already sized for the device pixel ratio and cleared, and draws the smallest
   TRUE picture of that sentence: the shape of the raw signal, the split the
   question turns on, the result the answer claims.

   The rules that apply everywhere apply here:
     - every value comes out of D. A thumbnail invented for the look of it is
       the same defect as a number typed into prose (§1.4).
     - every colour through PC.css("--token"), read at draw time; no literal hex
       (§4.2). The strip repaints on both theme signals, so a cached colour is a
       thumbnail stuck in the old theme.
     - no axes, no legend, no tick labels, no tooltip. It is 72px tall; the
       panel it summarises carries the real chart, and this points at it.

   A painter left `null` renders a sentence-only panel, which is what a demo
   with nothing honest to draw at 72px should ship. Worked example:

     const STORY_PAINTERS = [
       function (cv, g) {                                    // ① the data
         const y = D.series.raw;
         const s = PC.scales(cv, [0, y.length - 1], PC.pad10(PC.extent(y)),
                             {l: 3, r: 3, t: 5, b: 5});
         g.strokeStyle = PC.css("--series-1"); g.lineWidth = 1.5;
         g.beginPath();
         y.forEach((v, i) => (i ? g.lineTo(s.x(i), s.y(v)) : g.moveTo(s.x(i), s.y(v))));
         g.stroke();
       },
       function (cv, g) { … },                               // ② the question
       function (cv, g) { … }                                // ③ the answer
     ];
*/
const STORY_PAINTERS = [
  function(cv,g){ paintMiniScatter(cv,g,A.ra,A.dec,PC.css("--series-1")); },
  function(cv,g){ paintMiniScatter(cv,g,A.pmra,A.pmdec,PC.css("--series-2")); },
  function(cv,g){ paintMiniMembership(cv,g,D.controlled_initial.model,D.controlled_defaults[D.controlled_initial.model]); }
];

/* -- WFMAP: the stages the analysis sections performs ------------------------------------
   Three cards for most demos, keeping the course diagram's numbering. Stage 1
   is preprocessing and belongs to Design matrix, so it is absent here — and the three
   that remain stay numbered 2, 3, 4. `anchor` is the id of a section INSIDE
   #top2; `desc` is one line, no numbers, no second sentence. */
const WFMAP = [
  {stage:2, anchor:"wf-2", title:"Transformation",       desc:"Keep the submitted matrix distinct from the controlled matrix."},
  {stage:3, anchor:"wf-3", title:"Modelling & training", desc:"Change one model premise while holding the physical inputs fixed."},
  {stage:4, anchor:"wf-4", title:"Evaluation",           desc:"Check one nearest-guide label in sky, motion, colour and distance views."}
];


/* Demo-specific runtime. Scientific fitting lives in precompute.py; this layer
   only switches stored arrays, draws them, and keeps one shared selection. */
function bytes(encoded){
  const raw=atob(encoded), out=new Uint8Array(raw.length);
  for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i++) out[i]=raw.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}
function typed(Type,encoded){return new Type(bytes(encoded).buffer);}
const A={
  source:typed(BigUint64Array,D.arrays.source_id_u64_b64),
  ra:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.ra_f64_b64),
  dec:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.dec_f64_b64),
  parallax:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.parallax_f64_b64),
  poe:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.parallax_over_error_f64_b64),
  pmra:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.pmra_f64_b64),
  pmdec:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.pmdec_f64_b64),
  g:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.g_mag_f64_b64),
  colour:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.bp_rp_f64_b64),
  eg:typed(Float64Array,D.arrays.e_g_mag_f64_b64),
  pca:typed(Float32Array,D.arrays.pca_xy_f32_b64),
  notebookPca:typed(Float32Array,D.arrays.notebook_pca_xy_f32_b64),
  notebookLabels:typed(Int16Array,D.arrays.notebook_gmm_labels_i16_b64),
  percentile:typed(Uint8Array,D.arrays.feature_percentiles_u8_b64)
};
const FAMILY_LABEL={gmm:"Gaussian mixture",dbscan:"DBSCAN",hdbscan:"HDBSCAN"};
const DEFAULT_CONFIG=D.controlled_defaults;
const EXAMPLE_LABEL={
  center:"Nearest to the motion–parallax guide",
  both_models:"Default GMM and HDBSCAN agree",
  gmm_only:"Default GMM-only selection",
  hdbscan_only:"Default HDBSCAN-only selection",
  boundary:"Near the default GMM probability boundary",
  field_control:"Typical field star"
};
const EXAMPLE_REASON={
  center:"Smallest scaled difference from the guide's motion and parallax.",
  both_models:"Selected by both default GMM and HDBSCAN fits.",
  gmm_only:"Selected only by the default GMM among all default fits.",
  hdbscan_only:"Selected only by default HDBSCAN among all default fits.",
  boundary:"Closest to the default Gaussian mixture's probability boundary.",
  field_control:"Near the median of sources rejected by all three default fits."
};
const FEATURE_ARRAY=[A.pmra,A.pmdec,A.parallax];
const configCache=new Map();
function configData(model,key){
  const cacheKey=model+":"+key;
  if(configCache.has(cacheKey)) return configCache.get(cacheKey);
  const record=D.configurations[model][key];
  const value={record,labels:typed(Int16Array,record.labels_i16_b64),score:typed(Float64Array,record.candidate_probability_f64_b64)};
  configCache.set(cacheKey,value);
  return value;
}
function esc(value){return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"})[ch]);}
function fmt(value,digits=2){return Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined,{maximumFractionDigits:digits});}
function sourceId(i){return A.source[i].toString();}
function z(i,j){return (FEATURE_ARRAY[j][i]-D.metadata.scaler_mean[j])/D.metadata.scaler_scale[j];}
function tick3(range){return [range[0],(range[0]+range[1])/2,range[1]];}
function flag(kind,label){
  const icon=kind==="ok"?"✓":kind==="warn"?"!":"×";
  return `<span class="flag ${kind}"><span aria-hidden="true">${icon}</span>${esc(label)}</span>`;
}
function candidateMask(state){
  const data=configData(state.model,state.config),threshold=state.threshold;
  const mask=new Uint8Array(A.ra.length);
  for(let i=0;i<mask.length;i++) mask[i]=data.labels[i]===data.record.candidate_label&&data.score[i]>=threshold?1:0;
  return mask;
}
function fittedRole(i,state,mask=candidateMask(state)){
  const data=configData(state.model,state.config),label=data.labels[i];
  if(label===data.record.candidate_label)return mask[i]?"candidate (shown)":"candidate (below threshold)";
  return label<0?"noise":"other group";
}
function shownCount(state){
  return configData(state.model,state.config).record.display_count_at_threshold[state.threshold.toFixed(2)];
}
function plottedPointTip(i,xLabel,x,yLabel,y,context=""){
  return `<b>Gaia ${sourceId(i)}</b><br><span class="k">${esc(xLabel)}</span> ${fmt(x,6)}<br><span class="k">${esc(yLabel)}</span> ${fmt(y,6)}${context?`<br>${context}`:""}`;
}
function astrometricContext(i,motion=true){
  const parallax=`<span class="k">parallax</span> ${fmt(A.parallax[i],6)} mas`;
  return motion?`<span class="k">motion</span> (${fmt(A.pmra[i],6)}, ${fmt(A.pmdec[i],6)}) mas yr⁻¹<br>${parallax}`:parallax;
}

const VIEW=PC.createViewState(
  {model:D.controlled_initial.model,config:D.controlled_defaults[D.controlled_initial.model],threshold:D.controlled_initial.threshold,selected:Number(D.examples.center),feature:0,example:"center",hovered:-1},
  {params:{
    model:{values:Object.keys(D.configurations)},
    config:{values:[...new Set(Object.values(D.configurations).flatMap(f=>Object.keys(f)))]},
    threshold:{type:"number",min:0.5,max:1,values:Array.from({length:11},(_,i)=>(10+i)/20),param:"cut"},
    selected:{type:"integer",min:0,max:A.ra.length-1,param:"source"},
    feature:{type:"integer",min:0,max:D.features.length-1,param:"feature"},
    example:{values:[...Object.entries(D.examples).filter(([,i])=>i!==null).map(([key])=>key),"custom"],param:"example"}
  }}
);
function normalizeInitialModelConfig(){const state=VIEW.get();if(!D.configurations[state.model][state.config])VIEW.set({config:DEFAULT_CONFIG[state.model]},{source:"url-model-config-normalization"});}
normalizeInitialModelConfig();
function reinforceSource(i){VIEW.set({hovered:i},{source:"derived-hover",url:false});}
function clearReinforcement(){VIEW.set({hovered:-1},{source:"derived-leave",url:false});PC.hideTip();}
function selectSource(i,source,extra={}){const state=VIEW.get(),keep=state.example!=="custom"&&Number(D.examples[state.example])===Number(i);VIEW.set({...extra,selected:i,example:keep?state.example:namedExampleFor(i),hovered:-1},{source});}
function renderHoverBridge(state){
  const explorer=document.getElementById("matrixExplorer"),readout=document.getElementById("dmHoverReadout");
  if(state.hovered>=0){explorer.dataset.hoverSource=String(state.hovered);readout.textContent=`Dashed outline: row X[${state.hovered},:], Gaia ${sourceId(state.hovered)}, the star under the pointer. Click it to select it.`;}
  else{delete explorer.dataset.hoverSource;readout.textContent="Hover over a star in any other chart to outline its row here; click to select it.";}
}
function namedExampleFor(index){return Object.entries(D.examples).find(([,i])=>i!==null&&Number(i)===Number(index))?.[0]||"custom";}
function normalizeInitialShareState(){
  const query=new URLSearchParams(location.search),state=VIEW.get(),hasSource=query.has("source"),hasExample=query.has("example");
  if(hasExample&&!hasSource&&state.example!=="custom"&&D.examples[state.example]!==null){VIEW.set({selected:Number(D.examples[state.example])},{source:"url-example-normalization"});return;}
  if(hasSource){const consistent=state.example!=="custom"&&Number(D.examples[state.example])===state.selected;VIEW.set({example:hasExample?(consistent?state.example:"custom"):namedExampleFor(state.selected)},{source:"url-source-normalization"});}
}
normalizeInitialShareState();

function buildProvenance(){
  const body=document.querySelector("#provTable tbody");
  body.innerHTML=D.provenance.claims.map(row=>`<tr><td>${esc(row.property)}</td><td>${esc(row.card_says)}</td><td>${esc(row.file_says)}<br><span class="note">${esc(row.note)}</span></td><td>${flag(row.verdict,row.verdict==="ok"?"confirmed":row.verdict==="bad"?"contradicted":"caution")}</td></tr>`).join("");
  document.getElementById("provSource").innerHTML=`Retained CSV <code>${esc(D.metadata.source_sha256)}</code> · retained notebook <code>${esc(D.notebook.sha256)}</code> · upstream ${esc(D.provenance.identifier)} · licence ${esc(D.provenance.licence)} · donor/course record ${esc(D.provenance.source)}. ESA record: <code data-audit="esa-record">${esc(D.provenance.upstream_url)}</code> · licence deed: <code>${esc(D.provenance.licence_url)}</code>. ${esc(D.provenance.changes_notice)}`;
  document.getElementById("gaiaAttribution").textContent=D.provenance.attribution;
}

  const p=D.provenance,n=D.notebook;
  const rows=[
    ["The cleaning reproduces exactly",`${D.metadata.raw_shape.join("×")} → ${D.metadata.complete_shape.join("×")} → ${D.metadata.clean_shape.join("×")}`,"Replaying the notebook's cleaning (complete rows only, four derived columns, positive parallax, small G-magnitude error) gives the table sizes the notebook saved."],
    ["The report lists fewer GMM inputs than the code uses",`${D.provenance.claims.find(x=>x.property==="Notebook GMM inputs").file_says}`,"The report names eight inputs to its Gaussian mixture model (GMM), but the code passes ten, including total proper motion and G-band flux."],
    ["The notebook's largest HDBSCAN group is field stars",`${Number(n.stored_hdbscan_counts["2"]).toLocaleString()} stars · ${fmt(n.stored_largest_group_centre.parallax,3)} mas`,"Its motion and parallax, and its spread across the whole field, do not match the compact Pleiades cluster."],
    ["The notebook's outputs are kept as stored",`${n.gallery.length.toLocaleString()} stored PNG outputs · ${n.error_outputs.toLocaleString()} stored errors`,"The submitted HDBSCAN results and the probability outputs of the run without a fixed random seed are kept exactly as the notebook saved them."],
    ["The file is the full 1° cone around the Pleiades",`CSV ${esc(D.metadata.source_sha256.slice(0,12))}…`,`The Dataset page reruns the archive query for all sources within 1° of the cluster centre and finds the same ${D.metadata.n_raw.toLocaleString()} sources, with matching counts and sums.`]
  ];
  document.getElementById("forensics").innerHTML=rows.map(r=>`<article class="finding"><h4>${r[0]}</h4><p class="ev">${r[1]}</p><p class="so"><b>Why it matters.</b> ${r[2]}</p></article>`).join("");
}
function buildNotebookAudit(){
  const n=D.notebook;
  document.getElementById("notebookAuditTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Evidence</th><th>Stored notebook says</th><th>Rebuild check</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    <tr><td>Execution</td><td>${n.executed_code_cells.toLocaleString()} executed code cells; ${n.png_outputs.toLocaleString()} PNG outputs</td><td>${n.error_outputs.toLocaleString()} stored errors</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Stored dataframe shapes</td><td>${n.stored_shapes.raw.join("×")} → ${n.stored_shapes.complete.join("×")} → ${n.stored_shapes.clean.join("×")}</td><td>${D.metadata.raw_shape.join("×")} → ${D.metadata.complete_shape.join("×")} → ${D.metadata.clean_shape.join("×")}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Seeded GMM group sizes</td><td>${Object.values(n.stored_gmm_k3_counts).map(Number).map(x=>x.toLocaleString()).join(" / ")}</td><td>${Object.values(n.recomputed_gmm_k3_counts).map(Number).map(x=>x.toLocaleString()).join(" / ")} · ${n.gmm_k3_reproduces?"exact match":"does not match"}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Five-component GMM fit score (negated lower bound)</td><td>${fmt(n.stored_gmm_k5_negated_lower_bound,15)}</td><td>${fmt(n.recomputed_gmm_k5_negated_lower_bound,15)} · ${n.gmm_k5_reproduces?"matches within 10⁻¹²":"does not match"}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Third-party HDBSCAN label counts</td><td>${Object.entries(n.stored_hdbscan_counts).map(([k,v])=>`${esc(k)}: ${Number(v).toLocaleString()}`).join(" · ")}</td><td>Kept as stored</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Probability tiers</td><td>${Object.values(n.stored_threshold_counts).map(Number).map(x=>x.toLocaleString()).join(" / ")}</td><td>From a run without a fixed random seed; kept as stored</td></tr>
  </tbody>`;
  document.getElementById("notebookAuditNote").textContent=`Notebook SHA-256 ${n.sha256}; kernel metadata records Python ${n.python}.`;
}
function buildNotebookTables(){
  const n=D.notebook, keys=[...new Set([...Object.keys(n.stored_gmm_k3_counts),...Object.keys(n.recomputed_gmm_k3_counts)])].sort();
  document.getElementById("notebookGmmTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Arbitrary label</th><th>Stored count</th><th>Recomputed count</th></tr></thead><tbody>${keys.map(k=>`<tr><td>${esc(k)}</td><td>${Number(n.stored_gmm_k3_counts[k]).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${Number(n.recomputed_gmm_k3_counts[k]).toLocaleString()}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>`;
  document.getElementById("notebookInterpretation").innerHTML=`<b>Result.</b> ${n.gmm_k3_reproduces?"Rerunning the seeded three-component model gives exactly the stored group sizes.":"Rerunning the seeded three-component model does not give the stored group sizes."} For the five-component model the notebook stored ${fmt(n.stored_gmm_k5_negated_lower_bound,15)} and the rerun gives ${fmt(n.recomputed_gmm_k5_negated_lower_bound,15)}${n.gmm_k5_reproduces?" (equal within 10⁻¹²)":" (not equal)"}. This number is a fit score: the negated per-star lower bound on the log-likelihood, not a total negative log-likelihood.`;
}
function buildControls(){
  const model=document.getElementById("modelSelect"),feature=document.getElementById("featureSelect"),example=document.getElementById("exampleSelect");
  model.innerHTML=Object.keys(D.configurations).map(k=>`<option value="${k}">${FAMILY_LABEL[k]}</option>`).join("");
  feature.innerHTML=D.features.map((f,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${esc(f.short)} · ${esc(f.unit)}</option>`).join("");
  example.innerHTML=Object.entries(D.examples).filter(([,i])=>i!==null).map(([k])=>`<option value="${k}">${esc(EXAMPLE_LABEL[k])}</option>`).join("")+`<option value="custom">Another star (picked in a chart or table)</option>`;
  model.addEventListener("change",()=>VIEW.set({model:model.value,config:DEFAULT_CONFIG[model.value]},{source:"model-control"}));
  document.getElementById("configSelect").addEventListener("change",event=>VIEW.set({config:event.target.value},{source:"config-control"}));
  document.getElementById("thresholdRange").addEventListener("input",event=>VIEW.set({threshold:Number(event.target.value)},{source:"threshold-control"}));
  feature.addEventListener("change",()=>VIEW.set({feature:Number(feature.value)},{source:"feature-control"}));
  example.addEventListener("change",()=>{if(example.value!=="custom")VIEW.set({selected:Number(D.examples[example.value]),example:example.value},{source:"example-control"});});
}
function buildDesignMatrix(){
  document.getElementById("heroValue").textContent=D.metadata.n_clean.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById("heroNote").textContent=`kept from ${D.metadata.n_raw.toLocaleString()} catalogue rows after quality cuts; each of the ${D.metadata.n_unique_sources.toLocaleString()} stars appears once.`;
  document.getElementById("statRow").innerHTML=`<div class="stat"><div class="v">${D.metadata.n_features}</div><div class="l">input columns</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="v">${D.metadata.pca_variance.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0).toLocaleString(undefined,{style:"percent",maximumFractionDigits:1})}</div><div class="l">of the variance kept by the two-axis PCA view</div></div><div class="stat"><div class="v">${D.metadata.g_error_limit_mag}</div><div class="l">G-magnitude error limit (mag)</div></div>`;
  document.getElementById("validationNote").textContent=`Set aside ${D.metadata.withheld_validation.length} columns for checking the clusters afterwards (${D.metadata.withheld_validation.map(item=>item.label).join(", ")}); none of them enters the matrix.`;
  document.getElementById("scaleNote").insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",` Each value is standardized with the stored means (${D.metadata.scaler_mean.map(x=>fmt(x,3)).join(", ")}) and scales (${D.metadata.scaler_scale.map(x=>fmt(x,3)).join(", ")}): z = (value − mean) / scale, so 0 is the column average and ±1 is one standard deviation away. PCA is used only for display.`);
  document.getElementById("scalerTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Matrix column</th><th>Unit</th><th>Stored mean</th><th>Stored scale</th><th>Model role</th></tr></thead><tbody>${D.features.map((feature,j)=>`<tr><td>${esc(feature.label)}</td><td>${esc(feature.unit)}</td><td>${fmt(D.metadata.scaler_mean[j],6)}</td><td>${fmt(D.metadata.scaler_scale[j],6)}</td><td>clustering input (standardized)</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>`;
}
function buildDefaultComparison(){
  document.getElementById("defaultComparisonTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Model</th><th>Default setting</th><th>Candidate stars</th><th>Noise stars</th><th>Jaccard overlap with default HDBSCAN</th></tr></thead><tbody>${Object.entries(D.default_comparison).map(([family,row])=>`<tr><td>${esc(FAMILY_LABEL[family])}</td><td>${esc(row.setting)}</td><td>${Number(row.candidate_count).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${Number(row.noise_count).toLocaleString()}</td><td>${fmt(row.jaccard_with_hdbscan_30,6)}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>`;
}
function defaultVotes(i){
  return Object.entries(DEFAULT_CONFIG).reduce((n,[m,k])=>{const c=configData(m,k);return n+(c.labels[i]===c.record.candidate_label?1:0);},0);
}
function buildExampleTable(){
  const body=document.querySelector("#exampleTable tbody");
  const grouped=[];for(const [key,i] of Object.entries(D.examples).filter(([,value])=>value!==null)){let row=grouped.find(x=>x.i===i);if(!row){row={i,keys:[]};grouped.push(row);}row.keys.push(key);}
  body.innerHTML=grouped.map(row=>`<tr data-key="${row.i}" data-example="${esc(row.keys[0])}"><td>${row.keys.map(key=>esc(EXAMPLE_LABEL[key])).join(" / ")}</td><td><code>${sourceId(row.i)}</code></td><td>${defaultVotes(row.i)} / ${Object.keys(D.configurations).length}</td><td>${row.keys.map(key=>esc(EXAMPLE_REASON[key])).join(" ")}</td></tr>`).join("");
}
let exampleRows;
function buildGlossary(){
  const groups=[
    ["Data",[["Gaia source","One object in the Gaia catalogue, identified by its source_id, and one row of the data. This page calls each source a star."],["Parallax","The small yearly shift in a star's apparent position as Earth orbits the Sun, in milliarcseconds (mas). Nearer stars shift more; distance in parsecs ≈ 1000 / parallax."],["Proper motion","A star's motion across the sky, in milliarcseconds per year, split into pmRA (along right ascension) and pmDec (along declination). pmRA already includes the cos(declination) factor."],["Colour–magnitude diagram","A plot of colour (BP−RP: blue-band minus red-band magnitude; larger means redder) against G magnitude, with brighter stars at the top. Stars of one age at one distance fall on one narrow band."]]],
    ["Model",[["Standardization","Subtract the stored feature mean and divide by the stored feature scale, so each column has mean 0 and standard deviation 1."],["PCA","Principal component analysis: rotates the standardized columns and keeps the two directions with the most spread, so the stars can be drawn on two axes. Used here for display only; the clustering in the controlled comparison uses all three columns."],["GMM","Gaussian mixture model: describes the stars as a mix of bell-shaped clouds (components) and gives each star a probability of belonging to each. Component numbers are arbitrary."],["DBSCAN","A density-based clustering method. Stars in dense regions (at least a minimum number of neighbours within a fixed radius, ε) form groups; isolated stars are left as noise."],["HDBSCAN","A hierarchical version of DBSCAN that finds dense groups across a range of densities instead of one fixed radius. The submitted notebook used a third-party HDBSCAN package; the controlled comparison uses scikit-learn's implementation."],["Noise","Stars that DBSCAN or HDBSCAN leave outside every group."],["Controlled comparison","This page's own comparison: every model is fitted on the same three standardized columns (pmRA, pmDec, parallax) of the same stars, so only the model and its setting change."]]],
    ["Evidence",[["Guide","A published Pleiades proper motion and parallax (Chulkov 2024), used only after fitting to pick the candidate group. No model is given it."],["Candidate group (nearest-guide group)","The group in a fit, excluding noise, whose motion and parallax lie closest to the guide, with each difference scaled by a broad tolerance. The Insight page calls it the Pleiades candidate."],["Credible candidate","A candidate group whose scaled distance from the guide is within the stated cutoff."],["Membership strength","A score from 0 to 1 for how firmly a star belongs to its group: a component probability, a density-based strength or a simple 0/1 inclusion, depending on the model."],["Display threshold","The minimum membership strength for a candidate star to be shown in the charts. It is applied after fitting and changes no labels."],["Jaccard overlap","Overlap between two groups: stars in both divided by stars in either (1 = identical). Each group here is compared with the default HDBSCAN candidate group."],["Stored notebook output","A figure or printed value saved in the submitted notebook when it was run."]]]
  ];
  document.getElementById("glossary-content").innerHTML=`<div class="gloss">${groups.map(([title,terms])=>`<h3>${title}</h3>${terms.map(([term,text])=>`<div class="term"><b>${term}</b><p>${text}</p></div>`).join("")}`).join("")}</div>`;
}

function paintMiniScatter(cv,g,xValues,yValues,colour){
  const w=parseFloat(cv.style.width)||cv.getBoundingClientRect().width,h=parseFloat(cv.style.height)||72;
  const xr=PC.extent(xValues),yr=PC.extent(yValues),sx=v=>(v-xr[0])/(xr[1]-xr[0])*w,sy=v=>h-(v-yr[0])/(yr[1]-yr[0])*h;
  for(let i=0;i<xValues.length;i+=D.metadata.story_field_stride)drawPoint(g,sx(xValues[i]),sy(yValues[i]),colour,4,.58);
}
function paintMiniMembership(cv,g,model,key){
  const c=configData(model,key),w=parseFloat(cv.style.width)||cv.getBoundingClientRect().width,h=parseFloat(cv.style.height)||72;
  const xr=D.metadata.display_ranges.pmra,yr=D.metadata.display_ranges.pmdec,sx=v=>(v-xr[0])/(xr[1]-xr[0])*w,sy=v=>h-(v-yr[0])/(yr[1]-yr[0])*h;
  for(let i=0;i<A.pmra.length;i+=D.metadata.story_field_stride)drawPoint(g,sx(A.pmra[i]),sy(A.pmdec[i]),PC.css("--muted"),4,.32);
  let candidate=0;for(let i=0;i<A.pmra.length;i++)if(c.labels[i]===c.record.candidate_label&&candidate++%D.metadata.story_candidate_stride===0)drawPoint(g,sx(A.pmra[i]),sy(A.pmdec[i]),PC.css("--series-1"),4,.9);
}
function inside(value,range){return value>=Math.min(...range)&&value<=Math.max(...range);}
function clampRange(value,range){return Math.max(Math.min(...range),Math.min(Math.max(...range),value));}
function histInterval(hist,k,digits=3,unit=""){
  const suffix=unit?` ${unit}`:"",last=hist.counts.length-1;
  if(k===0)return `≤ ${fmt(hist.edges[1],digits)}${suffix}`;
  if(k===last)return `≥ ${fmt(hist.edges[k],digits)}${suffix}`;
  return `${fmt(hist.edges[k],digits)}–${fmt(hist.edges[k+1],digits)}${suffix}`;
}
function drawPoint(g,x,y,fill,r=4,alpha=1){
  r=Math.max(4,r);
  g.globalAlpha=1;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--surface-1");g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r+1.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();
  g.globalAlpha=alpha;g.fillStyle=fill;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.globalAlpha=1;
}
function selectedPoint(g,x,y,fill,r=4){
  r=Math.max(4,r);g.globalAlpha=1;g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--text-primary");g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r+5,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();drawPoint(g,x,y,fill,r,1);
}
function verticalBar(g,x,y,width,bottom,fill,alpha=1){
  const h=Math.max(0,bottom-y),r=Math.min(4,width/2,h/2);
  if(h<=0||width<=0)return;
  g.globalAlpha=alpha;g.fillStyle=fill;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,bottom);g.lineTo(x,y+r);g.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);g.lineTo(x+width-r,y);g.quadraticCurveTo(x+width,y,x+width,y+r);g.lineTo(x+width,bottom);g.closePath();g.fill();g.globalAlpha=1;
}
const POINT_TABLE_BINDINGS=new Map();
function renderPointTable(tableId,indices,state,xValues,yValues,xLabel,yLabel,roleFor){
  const table=document.getElementById(tableId);if(!table)return;
  const activeKey=table.contains(document.activeElement)?document.activeElement.dataset.key:null;
  table.innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Gaia source ID</th><th>Role</th><th>${esc(xLabel)}</th><th>${esc(yLabel)}</th></tr></thead><tbody>${indices.map(i=>{const role=roleFor(i);return `<tr data-key="${i}"><td><code>${sourceId(i)}</code></td><td>${esc(i===state.selected?`selected · ${role}`:role)}</td><td>${fmt(xValues[i],6)}</td><td>${fmt(yValues[i],6)}</td></tr>`;}).join("")}</tbody>`;
  if(!POINT_TABLE_BINDINGS.has(tableId))POINT_TABLE_BINDINGS.set(tableId,PC.bindTableRows(table,{key:row=>Number(row.dataset.key),selected:()=>VIEW.get().selected,onSelect:key=>selectSource(key,tableId+"-table"),onClear:()=>VIEW.set({selected:Number(D.examples.center),example:"center",hovered:-1},{source:tableId+"-table"})}));
  POINT_TABLE_BINDINGS.get(tableId).refresh(()=>VIEW.get().selected);
  if(activeKey!==null){const focusRow=table.querySelector(`tbody tr[data-key="${activeKey}"]`)||table.querySelector('tbody tr[aria-selected="true"]');if(focusRow){table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr").forEach(row=>row.tabIndex=-1);focusRow.tabIndex=0;focusRow.focus();}}
}
function drawScatter(canvasId,xValues,yValues,xRange,yRange,xLabel,yLabel,state,options={}){
  const cv=document.getElementById(canvasId),g=PC.fit(cv),s=PC.scales(cv,xRange,yRange,{l:58,r:15,t:14,b:54}),box=PC.boxOf(s);
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,tick3(xRange),tick3(yRange),s.x,s.y,xLabel,yLabel);
  const mask=candidateMask(state),selected=state.selected,points=[],drawn=[];let selectedClamped=false;
  g.save();g.beginPath();g.rect(box.left,box.top,box.right-box.left,box.bottom-box.top);g.clip();
  for(let pass=0;pass<2;pass++){
    for(let i=0;i<xValues.length;i++){
      const member=!!mask[i];
      if((pass===0&&member)||(pass===1&&!member)||(!member&&i%D.metadata.field_display_stride!==0&&i!==selected))continue;
      const outside=!inside(xValues[i],xRange)||!inside(yValues[i],yRange);if(outside&&i!==selected)continue;if(outside)selectedClamped=true;
      const px=s.x(clampRange(xValues[i],xRange)),py=s.y(clampRange(yValues[i],yRange)),colour=member?PC.css("--series-1"):PC.css("--muted");
      if(i===selected)selectedPoint(g,px,py,colour);else drawPoint(g,px,py,colour,4,member?.86:.58);
      points.push([px,py,i]);drawn.push(i);
    }
  }
  if(options.reference){
    const x=s.x(D.reference.pmra),y=s.y(D.reference.pmdec);
    g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--axis");g.lineWidth=1;g.setLineDash([4,3]);
    g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x-8,y);g.lineTo(x+8,y);g.moveTo(x,y-8);g.lineTo(x,y+8);g.stroke();g.setLineDash([]);
    g.font=PC.font.tick();g.textAlign="left";g.textBaseline="bottom";g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.fillText("guide",x+10,y-5);
  }
  g.restore();
  let clipped=0;for(let i=0;i<xValues.length;i++)if(!inside(xValues[i],xRange)||!inside(yValues[i],yRange))clipped++;
  const readout=document.getElementById(options.readoutId||"");
  const baseReadout=`${drawn.length.toLocaleString()} dots: every candidate star shown at this threshold, every ${D.metadata.field_display_stride}th other star, and the selected star. `+(clipped?`${clipped.toLocaleString()} stars lie outside the plotted range. `:"")+(selectedClamped?"The selected star lies outside the range and is drawn at the nearest edge; its tooltip and table give its true values. ":"")+"Hover over a dot to read its values; click it to select that star in every chart.";
  if(readout)readout.textContent=baseReadout;
  if(options.tableId)renderPointTable(options.tableId,drawn,state,xValues,yValues,xLabel,yLabel,i=>fittedRole(i,state,mask));
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(i,event)=>{reinforceSource(i);let context=canvasId==="motionCanvas"?astrometricContext(i,false):astrometricContext(i,true);if(!inside(xValues[i],xRange)||!inside(yValues[i],yRange))context+=`<br><span class="k">drawn</span> at the plot edge (outside the range)`;PC.tip(plottedPointTip(i,xLabel,xValues[i],yLabel,yValues[i],context),event);if(readout)readout.textContent=`Gaia ${sourceId(i)}: click to select this star.`;},onLeave:()=>{clearReinforcement();if(readout)readout.textContent=baseReadout;},onClick:i=>selectSource(i,canvasId)});
  return drawn;
}
function drawMatrix(state){
  const cv=document.getElementById("matrixCanvas"),g=PC.fit(cv),w=parseFloat(cv.style.width),h=parseFloat(cv.style.height),left=50,top=30,right=12,bottom=24,rows=15;
  let rowIds=Array.from({length:rows},(_,r)=>Math.round(r*(A.ra.length-1)/(rows-1)));
  const middle=Math.floor(rows/2);rowIds[middle]=state.selected;if(state.hovered>=0&&state.hovered!==state.selected)rowIds[middle-1]=state.hovered;
  rowIds=[...new Set(rowIds)];for(let r=0;rowIds.length<rows&&r<A.ra.length;r++){const candidate=Math.round(r*(A.ra.length-1)/(rows-1));if(!rowIds.includes(candidate))rowIds.push(candidate);}rowIds.sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  const cellW=(w-left-right)/D.features.length,cellH=(h-top-bottom)/rows,points=[],meta=[];
  g.font=PC.font.tick();g.textAlign="center";g.textBaseline="bottom";g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");
  D.features.forEach((feature,j)=>g.fillText(feature.short,left+(j+.5)*cellW,top-8));
  rowIds.forEach((row,r)=>{
    for(let j=0;j<D.features.length;j++){
      const x=left+j*cellW,y=top+r*cellH,value=z(row,j);
      g.fillStyle=PC.divColor(Math.max(-1,Math.min(1,value/3)));g.fillRect(x+1,y+1,cellW-2,cellH-2);
      if(row===state.selected){g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--matrix-row");g.lineWidth=2;g.strokeRect(left+.5,y+.5,cellW*D.features.length-1,cellH-1);}
      if(row===state.hovered){g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--matrix-row");g.lineWidth=4;g.setLineDash([4,3]);g.strokeRect(left+2,y+2,cellW*D.features.length-4,cellH-4);g.setLineDash([]);}
      if(j===state.feature){g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--matrix-column");g.lineWidth=1.5;g.strokeRect(x+.5,top+.5,cellW-1,cellH*rows-1);}
      if(row===state.selected&&j===state.feature){g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--matrix-cell");g.lineWidth=3;g.strokeRect(x+2,y+2,cellW-4,cellH-4);}
      points.push([x+cellW/2,y+cellH/2,meta.length]);meta.push({row,feature:j,value});
    }
  });
  g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--axis");g.lineWidth=1;g.strokeRect(left+.5,top+.5,cellW*D.features.length-1,cellH*rows-1);
  g.fillStyle=PC.css("--muted");g.textAlign="right";g.textBaseline="middle";g.fillText("rows",left-8,top+cellH*rows/2);
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(k,event)=>{const m=meta[k];PC.tip(`<b>X[${m.row}, ${m.feature}]</b><br>${esc(D.features[m.feature].short)} z = ${fmt(m.value,3)}<br>Gaia ${sourceId(m.row)}`,event);},onLeave:()=>PC.hideTip(),onClick:k=>{const m=meta[k];selectSource(m.row,"matrix-canvas",{feature:m.feature});}});
}
function drawRow(state){
  const cv=document.getElementById("rowCanvas"),g=PC.fit(cv),range=[0,100],s=PC.scales(cv,[-.4,D.features.length-.6],range,{l:45,r:12,t:14,b:54}),box=PC.boxOf(s),points=[];
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,D.features.map((_,i)=>i),[0,25,50,75,100],s.x,s.y,"feature","within-column percentile",{xFmt:i=>D.features[i].short});
  D.features.forEach((feature,j)=>{const value=A.percentile[state.selected*D.features.length+j],x=s.x(j),y=s.y(value);g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--axis");g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,s.y(0));g.lineTo(x,y);g.stroke();drawPoint(g,x,y,j===state.feature?PC.css("--matrix-cell"):PC.css("--matrix-row"),5,1);points.push([x,y,j]);});
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(j,event)=>PC.tip(`<b>${esc(D.features[j].label)}</b><br>raw ${fmt(FEATURE_ARRAY[j][state.selected],3)} ${esc(D.features[j].unit)}<br>shared percentile ${A.percentile[state.selected*D.features.length+j]}<br>z = ${fmt(z(state.selected,j),3)}`,event),onLeave:()=>PC.hideTip(),onClick:j=>VIEW.set({feature:j},{source:"row-canvas"})});
}
function drawColumn(state){
  const feature=D.features[state.feature],hist=D.histograms[feature.key],cv=document.getElementById("columnCanvas"),g=PC.fit(cv),max=Math.max(...hist.counts),s=PC.scales(cv,[hist.q01,hist.q99],[0,max*1.08],{l:58,r:12,t:14,b:54}),box=PC.boxOf(s),points=[];
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,tick3([hist.q01,hist.q99]),tick3([0,max]),s.x,s.y,`${feature.short} (${feature.unit})`,"stars");
  hist.counts.forEach((count,k)=>{const x0=s.x(hist.edges[k]),x1=s.x(hist.edges[k+1]),y=s.y(count);verticalBar(g,x0+1,y,Math.max(1,x1-x0-2),box.bottom,PC.css("--matrix-column"),.74);points.push([(x0+x1)/2,y,k]);});
  const value=FEATURE_ARRAY[state.feature][state.selected],lineX=s.x(Math.max(hist.q01,Math.min(hist.q99,value)));g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--matrix-cell");g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(lineX,box.top);g.lineTo(lineX,box.bottom);g.stroke();
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(k,event)=>PC.tip(`<b>${esc(histInterval(hist,k,3,feature.unit))}</b><br>${hist.counts[k].toLocaleString()} stars`,event),onLeave:()=>PC.hideTip(),onClick:k=>{const middle=(hist.edges[k]+hist.edges[k+1])/2;let best=0,distance=Infinity;for(let i=0;i<A.ra.length;i++){const d=Math.abs(FEATURE_ARRAY[state.feature][i]-middle);if(d<distance){distance=d;best=i;}}selectSource(best,"column-canvas");}});
}
function renderDesignTables(state){
  document.getElementById("dmCellReadout").textContent=`x[${state.selected}, ${state.feature}] = ${fmt(z(state.selected,state.feature),3)} · Gaia ${sourceId(state.selected)}`;
  document.getElementById("dmRowReadout").textContent=`X[${state.selected},:] · Gaia ${sourceId(state.selected)}. Click a dot to select that measurement.`;
  const hist=D.histograms[D.features[state.feature].key];
  document.getElementById("dmColumnReadout").textContent=`X[:,${state.feature}] · the first and last bars also hold the ${hist.below_count.toLocaleString()} values below ${fmt(hist.q01,3)} and the ${hist.above_count.toLocaleString()} values above ${fmt(hist.q99,3)} ${D.features[state.feature].unit}.`;
  document.getElementById("dmRowTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Feature</th><th>Raw value</th><th>Standardized value</th><th>Percentile</th></tr></thead><tbody>${D.features.map((f,j)=>`<tr><td>${esc(f.label)}</td><td>${fmt(FEATURE_ARRAY[j][state.selected],4)} ${esc(f.unit)}</td><td>${fmt(z(state.selected,j),4)}</td><td>${A.percentile[state.selected*D.features.length+j]}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>`;
  document.getElementById("dmColumnTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>${esc(D.features[state.feature].short)} interval</th><th>Count</th></tr></thead><tbody>${hist.counts.map((count,k)=>`<tr><td>${esc(histInterval(hist,k,4,D.features[state.feature].unit))}</td><td>${count.toLocaleString()}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>`;
}
function drawNotebookPca(state){
  const cv=document.getElementById("notebookPcaCanvas"),g=PC.fit(cv),xr=D.notebook.pca_ranges.x,yr=D.notebook.pca_ranges.y,s=PC.scales(cv,xr,yr,{l:58,r:14,t:14,b:54}),box=PC.boxOf(s),points=[],drawn=[],pcaX=[],pcaY=[];let selectedClamped=false,clipped=0;
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,tick3(xr),tick3(yr),s.x,s.y,"ten-feature PC1","ten-feature PC2");
  const colours=[PC.css("--series-1"),PC.css("--series-2"),PC.css("--series-3")];
  g.save();g.beginPath();g.rect(box.left,box.top,box.right-box.left,box.bottom-box.top);g.clip();
  for(let i=0;i<A.ra.length;i++){
    const x=A.notebookPca[2*i],y=A.notebookPca[2*i+1],outside=!inside(x,xr)||!inside(y,yr);if(outside)clipped++;if(i%D.metadata.notebook_display_stride!==0&&i!==state.selected)continue;if(outside&&i!==state.selected)continue;if(outside)selectedClamped=true;
    const px=s.x(clampRange(x,xr)),py=s.y(clampRange(y,yr)),colour=colours[A.notebookLabels[i]]||PC.css("--muted");if(i===state.selected)selectedPoint(g,px,py,colour);else drawPoint(g,px,py,colour,4,.72);points.push([px,py,i]);drawn.push(i);pcaX[i]=x;pcaY[i]=y;
  }
  g.restore();
  document.getElementById("notebookPcaReadout").textContent=`${drawn.length.toLocaleString()} dots: every ${D.metadata.notebook_display_stride}th star plus the selected star, coloured by the label the rerun mixture model gives it (the label numbers are arbitrary). Selected: Gaia ${sourceId(state.selected)}, label ${A.notebookLabels[state.selected]}. ${clipped.toLocaleString()} stars lie outside the plotted range.${selectedClamped?" The selected star lies outside the range and is drawn at the nearest edge; the table keeps its true coordinates.":""}`;
  renderPointTable("notebookPcaTable",drawn,state,pcaX,pcaY,"ten-feature PC1","ten-feature PC2",i=>`submitted GMM label ${A.notebookLabels[i]}`);
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(i,event)=>{reinforceSource(i);let context=astrometricContext(i,true);if(!inside(A.notebookPca[2*i],xr)||!inside(A.notebookPca[2*i+1],yr))context+=`<br><span class="k">drawn</span> at the plot edge (outside the range)`;PC.tip(`${plottedPointTip(i,"ten-feature PC1",A.notebookPca[2*i],"ten-feature PC2",A.notebookPca[2*i+1],context)}<br><span class="k">submitted GMM label</span> ${A.notebookLabels[i]}`,event);},onLeave:clearReinforcement,onClick:i=>selectSource(i,"notebook-pca")});
}
function drawControlledPca(state){
  const cv=document.getElementById("controlledPcaCanvas"),g=PC.fit(cv),xr=D.metadata.display_ranges.pca_x,yr=D.metadata.display_ranges.pca_y,s=PC.scales(cv,xr,yr,{l:58,r:14,t:14,b:54}),box=PC.boxOf(s),mask=candidateMask(state),points=[],drawn=[];let selectedClamped=false,clipped=0;
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,tick3(xr),tick3(yr),s.x,s.y,"three-feature PC1","three-feature PC2");
  g.save();g.beginPath();g.rect(box.left,box.top,box.right-box.left,box.bottom-box.top);g.clip();
  for(let pass=0;pass<2;pass++)for(let i=0;i<A.ra.length;i++){
    const member=!!mask[i],x=A.pca[2*i],y=A.pca[2*i+1],outside=!inside(x,xr)||!inside(y,yr);if(pass===0&&outside)clipped++;if((pass===0&&member)||(pass===1&&!member)||(!member&&i%D.metadata.field_display_stride!==0&&i!==state.selected))continue;if(outside&&i!==state.selected)continue;if(outside)selectedClamped=true;
    const px=s.x(clampRange(x,xr)),py=s.y(clampRange(y,yr)),colour=member?PC.css("--series-1"):PC.css("--muted");if(i===state.selected)selectedPoint(g,px,py,PC.css("--matrix-cell"));else drawPoint(g,px,py,colour,4,member?.86:.58);points.push([px,py,i]);drawn.push(i);
  }
  g.restore();
  document.getElementById("controlledPcaReadout").textContent=`${drawn.length.toLocaleString()} dots: every candidate star shown at this threshold, every ${D.metadata.field_display_stride}th other star, and the selected star. ${shownCount(state).toLocaleString()} stars are candidates at or above the display threshold; ${clipped.toLocaleString()} stars lie outside the plotted range. Selected: Gaia ${sourceId(state.selected)}.${selectedClamped?" It lies outside the range and is drawn at the nearest edge; the table keeps its true coordinates.":""}`;
  const pcaX={length:A.ra.length},pcaY={length:A.ra.length};for(let i of drawn){pcaX[i]=A.pca[2*i];pcaY[i]=A.pca[2*i+1];}
  renderPointTable("controlledPcaTable",drawn,state,pcaX,pcaY,"three-feature PC1","three-feature PC2",i=>fittedRole(i,state,mask));
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(i,event)=>{reinforceSource(i);let context=astrometricContext(i,true)+`<br><span class="k">assignment</span> ${esc(fittedRole(i,state,mask))}`;if(!inside(A.pca[2*i],xr)||!inside(A.pca[2*i+1],yr))context+=`<br><span class="k">drawn</span> at the plot edge (outside the range)`;PC.tip(plottedPointTip(i,"three-feature PC1",A.pca[2*i],"three-feature PC2",A.pca[2*i+1],context),event);},onLeave:clearReinforcement,onClick:i=>selectSource(i,"controlled-pca")});
}
function drawScore(state){
  const record=configData(state.model,state.config).record,hist=record.score_histogram,cv=document.getElementById("scoreCanvas"),g=PC.fit(cv),max=Math.max(...hist.counts),s=PC.scales(cv,[0,1],[0,max*1.08],{l:58,r:14,t:14,b:54}),box=PC.boxOf(s),points=[];
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,[0,.5,1],tick3([0,max]),s.x,s.y,"membership strength","stars");
  const passing=hist.counts.map((count,k)=>state.threshold===1?(k===hist.counts.length-1?hist.exact_one_count:0):(hist.edges[k]+1e-12>=state.threshold?count:0));
  hist.counts.forEach((count,k)=>{const lo=hist.edges[k],hi=hist.edges[k+1],x0=s.x(lo),x1=s.x(hi),y=s.y(count),region=passing[k]===count&&count>0;verticalBar(g,x0+1,y,Math.max(1,x1-x0-2),box.bottom,region?PC.css("--series-1"):PC.css("--muted"),.78);points.push([(x0+x1)/2,y,k]);});
  if(state.threshold===1&&hist.exact_one_count)verticalBar(g,box.right-4,s.y(hist.exact_one_count),3,box.bottom,PC.css("--series-1"),.9);
  const cut=s.x(state.threshold);g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--axis");g.lineWidth=1;g.setLineDash([4,3]);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(cut,box.top);g.lineTo(cut,box.bottom);g.stroke();g.setLineDash([]);g.font=PC.font.tick();g.textAlign="left";g.textBaseline="top";g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.fillText("cut",Math.min(cut+5,box.right-18),box.top+4);
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(k,event)=>PC.tip(`<b>strength ${fmt(hist.edges[k],2)}–${fmt(hist.edges[k+1],2)}</b><br>${hist.counts[k].toLocaleString()} candidate stars<br>${passing[k].toLocaleString()} shown at the current threshold`,event),onLeave:()=>PC.hideTip()});
  document.getElementById("scoreReadout").textContent=`Only the ${record.candidate_count.toLocaleString()} stars assigned to the candidate group are counted; the other ${hist.excluded_count.toLocaleString()} stars (other groups and noise) are left out. Bars at or above the dashed line marked cut are drawn in the candidate colour; those stars are shown in the charts. The cut is applied after fitting.`;
  document.getElementById("scoreTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Strength interval</th><th>Candidate stars</th><th>Shown at current threshold</th><th>Relative to threshold</th></tr></thead><tbody>${hist.counts.map((count,k)=>{const last=k===hist.counts.length-1,above=state.threshold<1&&hist.edges[k]+1e-12>=state.threshold,relation=last&&state.threshold===1?`contains the 1.00 threshold; only the ${hist.exact_one_count.toLocaleString()} stars with strength exactly 1 pass`:above?"at or above threshold":"below threshold";return `<tr><td>${fmt(hist.edges[k],2)}–${fmt(hist.edges[k+1],2)}</td><td>${count.toLocaleString()}</td><td>${passing[k].toLocaleString()}</td><td>${relation}</td></tr>`;}).join("")}</tbody>`;
}
function drawGroups(state){
  const record=configData(state.model,state.config).record,rows=record.clusters,cv=document.getElementById("groupCanvas"),g=PC.fit(cv),max=Math.max(...rows.map(r=>r.size)),s=PC.scales(cv,[-.6,rows.length-.4],[0,max*1.08],{l:58,r:14,t:14,b:54}),box=PC.boxOf(s),points=[];
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,rows.map((_,i)=>i),tick3([0,max]),s.x,s.y,"group label","stars",{xFmt:i=>String(rows[i].label)});
  rows.forEach((row,k)=>{const x0=s.x(k-.35),x1=s.x(k+.35),y=s.y(row.size);verticalBar(g,x0,y,x1-x0,box.bottom,row.candidate?PC.css("--series-1"):row.noise?PC.css("--muted"):PC.css("--series-2"),.8);points.push([s.x(k),y,k]);});
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(k,event)=>{const row=rows[k];PC.tip(`<b>label ${row.label}</b><br>${row.size.toLocaleString()} stars<br>distance from guide ${fmt(row.reference_offset,2)}`,event);},onLeave:()=>PC.hideTip()});
}
function renderClusterTable(state){
  const rows=configData(state.model,state.config).record.clusters;
  document.getElementById("clusterTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Label</th><th>Role</th><th>Stars</th><th>Median pmRA</th><th>Median pmDec</th><th>Median parallax</th><th>Distance from guide</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(row=>`<tr><td>${row.label}</td><td>${row.candidate?"candidate":row.noise?"noise":"other"}</td><td>${row.size.toLocaleString()}</td><td>${fmt(row.median_pmra)}</td><td>${fmt(row.median_pmdec)}</td><td>${fmt(row.median_parallax,3)}</td><td>${fmt(row.reference_offset,2)}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>`;
}
function drawParallax(state){
  const record=configData(state.model,state.config).record,hist=D.histograms.parallax,candidateCounts=record.candidate_parallax_counts_by_threshold[state.threshold.toFixed(2)],remainderCounts=hist.counts.map((count,k)=>count-candidateCounts[k]),cv=document.getElementById("parallaxCanvas"),g=PC.fit(cv),max=Math.max(...hist.counts),s=PC.scales(cv,[hist.q01,hist.q99],[0,max*1.08],{l:58,r:14,t:14,b:54}),box=PC.boxOf(s),points=[];
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,tick3([hist.q01,hist.q99]),tick3([0,max]),s.x,s.y,"parallax (mas)","stars");
  hist.counts.forEach((count,k)=>{const x0=s.x(hist.edges[k]),x1=s.x(hist.edges[k+1]),y=s.y(remainderCounts[k]),cy=s.y(candidateCounts[k]);verticalBar(g,x0+1,y,Math.max(1,x1-x0-2),box.bottom,PC.css("--muted"),.58);verticalBar(g,x0+2,cy,Math.max(1,x1-x0-4),box.bottom,PC.css("--series-1"),.86);points.push([(x0+x1)/2,Math.min(y,cy),k]);});
  PC.hover(cv,points,{onHit:(k,event)=>PC.tip(`<b>${esc(histInterval(hist,k,3,"mas"))}</b><br>all stars ${hist.counts[k].toLocaleString()} · other stars ${remainderCounts[k].toLocaleString()} · candidate stars shown ${candidateCounts[k].toLocaleString()}`,event),onLeave:()=>PC.hideTip()});
  document.getElementById("parallaxReadout").textContent=`Candidate stars shown at this threshold are drawn over all other stars (grey). The first and last bars also hold the ${hist.below_count.toLocaleString()} lowest and ${hist.above_count.toLocaleString()} highest parallax values.`;
  document.getElementById("parallaxTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Parallax interval</th><th>All stars</th><th>Other stars</th><th>Candidate stars shown</th></tr></thead><tbody>${hist.counts.map((count,k)=>`<tr><td>${esc(histInterval(hist,k,3,"mas"))}</td><td>${count.toLocaleString()}</td><td>${remainderCounts[k].toLocaleString()}</td><td>${candidateCounts[k].toLocaleString()}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>`;
}
function renderModelStatus(state){
  const record=configData(state.model,state.config).record,credible=record.candidate_credible;
  document.getElementById("modelStatus").innerHTML=`${flag(credible?"ok":"bad",credible?"credible candidate":"no credible candidate at this setting")}<span>${shownCount(state).toLocaleString()} stars shown · scaled distance from guide ${fmt(record.candidate_offset,2)} (credible if ≤ ${fmt(D.reference.credibility_cutoff,1)})</span>`;
  document.getElementById("motionReferenceStatus").innerHTML=`${flag("warn","post-fit reference")}<span>Guide: the published Pleiades motion (${fmt(D.reference.pmra,2)}, ${fmt(D.reference.pmdec,2)}) mas yr⁻¹, marked by the dashed cross. No model is given it.</span>`;
  const fields=[
    ["Model",FAMILY_LABEL[state.model]],["Setting",String(record.parameter)],["Candidate group label",String(record.candidate_label)],
    ["Candidate stars",record.candidate_count.toLocaleString()],["Noise stars",record.noise_count.toLocaleString()],["Jaccard overlap with default HDBSCAN",fmt(record.jaccard_with_hdbscan_30,3)]
  ];
  if(record.converged!==undefined){fields.push(["Converged",record.converged?"yes":"no"],["Iterations",record.iterations.toLocaleString()],["Average log likelihood",fmt(record.average_log_likelihood,4)]);}
  if(record.min_samples!==undefined)fields.push(["Fixed minimum samples",record.min_samples.toLocaleString()]);
  document.getElementById("fitDiagnostics").innerHTML=`<dl class="kv">${fields.map(([k,v])=>`<dt>${esc(k)}</dt><dd>${esc(v)}</dd>`).join("")}</dl><div class="callout"><b>The guide.</b> A published Pleiades proper motion and parallax, used after fitting to pick the candidate group; no model is given it. ${esc(D.reference.source)}</div>`;
}
function renderControls(state){
  const model=document.getElementById("modelSelect"),config=document.getElementById("configSelect"),threshold=document.getElementById("thresholdRange"),feature=document.getElementById("featureSelect"),example=document.getElementById("exampleSelect");
  model.value=state.model;
  config.innerHTML=Object.keys(D.configurations[state.model]).map(key=>`<option value="${key}">${esc(settingLabel(state.model,key))}</option>`).join("");config.value=state.config;
  threshold.value=state.threshold;document.getElementById("thresholdOut").value=fmt(state.threshold,2);feature.value=String(state.feature);
  const matches=state.example!=="custom"&&Number(D.examples[state.example])===state.selected;example.value=matches?state.example:"custom";
  for(const [target,source] of [['evalModel','modelSelect'],['evalConfig','configSelect']]){const el=document.getElementById(target);el.innerHTML=document.getElementById(source).innerHTML;el.value=document.getElementById(source).value;}
  const cut=document.getElementById('evalCut');cut.innerHTML=Array.from({length:11},(_,i)=>'<option value="'+((10+i)/20)+'">'+((10+i)/20).toFixed(2)+'</option>').join('');cut.value=state.threshold;
}
function settingLabel(model,key){
  const record=D.configurations[model][key];
  if(model==="gmm")return `components = ${record.parameter}`;
  if(model==="dbscan")return `epsilon = ${fmt(record.parameter,2)} · min samples = ${record.min_samples}`;
  return `minimum cluster size = ${record.parameter} · min samples = ${record.min_samples}`;
}
function renderSelectedSource(state){
  const i=state.selected,c=configData(state.model,state.config),assigned=c.labels[i]===c.record.candidate_label,score=c.score[i];
  document.getElementById("selectedSourceTable").innerHTML=`<thead><tr><th>Field</th><th>Value</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    <tr><td>Gaia source ID</td><td><code>${sourceId(i)}</code></td></tr><tr><td>Right ascension</td><td>${fmt(A.ra[i],6)}°</td></tr><tr><td>Declination</td><td>${fmt(A.dec[i],6)}°</td></tr>
    <tr><td>pmRA</td><td>${fmt(A.pmra[i],4)} mas yr⁻¹</td></tr><tr><td>pmDec</td><td>${fmt(A.pmdec[i],4)} mas yr⁻¹</td></tr><tr><td>Parallax</td><td>${fmt(A.parallax[i],5)} mas</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Parallax / uncertainty</td><td>${fmt(A.poe[i],3)}</td></tr><tr><td>BP−RP</td><td>${fmt(A.colour[i],4)} mag</td></tr><tr><td>G magnitude</td><td>${fmt(A.g[i],4)} mag</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Group label (current fit)</td><td>${c.labels[i]}</td></tr><tr><td>Membership strength</td><td>${fmt(score,3)}</td></tr><tr><td>Shown as a candidate star</td><td>${assigned&&score>=state.threshold?"yes":"no"}</td></tr>
  </tbody>`;
  document.getElementById("selectedSourceNote").textContent=`${defaultVotes(i)} of the three default fits put this star in the candidate group (before the display threshold). The selection is shared by the matrix, PCA, sky, motion and colour–magnitude charts.`;
  if(exampleRows)exampleRows.refresh();
}
function buildConclusions(state){
  const n=D.notebook,record=configData(state.model,state.config).record,candidate=record.clusters.find(row=>row.candidate),credible=record.candidate_credible;
  const items=[
    ["The notebook's largest HDBSCAN group is the background field, not the Pleiades",`The submitted notebook took its largest HDBSCAN group to be the cluster. Its own stored plots show that group spread across the whole field rather than forming a compact group of stars moving together.`,`Stored largest group: ${Number(n.stored_hdbscan_counts["2"]).toLocaleString()} stars · mean parallax ${fmt(n.stored_largest_group_centre.parallax,3)} mas (guide: ${fmt(D.reference.parallax,2)} mas) · inverse-parallax distance ${fmt(n.stored_largest_group_centre.distance_pc,0)} pc.`],
    [credible?"This setting finds a credible Pleiades candidate":"This setting finds no credible candidate",credible?`The group closest to the guide lies within the cutoff distance, so it counts as a credible candidate.`:`Even the group closest to the guide lies beyond the cutoff distance.`,`Current ${FAMILY_LABEL[state.model]} setting ${settingLabel(state.model,state.config)} · group ${candidate.size.toLocaleString()} stars · scaled distance from guide ${fmt(candidate.reference_offset,2)} (cutoff ${fmt(D.reference.credibility_cutoff,1)}) · shown at threshold ${fmt(state.threshold,2)}: ${shownCount(state).toLocaleString()} stars.`],
    ["The three default fits pick out nearly the same group",`With their default settings, the Gaussian mixture, DBSCAN and HDBSCAN fits on the same three columns return largely overlapping candidate groups.`,`Jaccard overlap of each default candidate group with default HDBSCAN: ${Object.entries(D.default_comparison).map(([family,row])=>`${FAMILY_LABEL[family]} ${fmt(row.jaccard_with_hdbscan_30,3)}`).join(" · ")} · current setting: ${fmt(record.jaccard_with_hdbscan_30,3)}.`]
  ];
  document.getElementById("conclusion-content").innerHTML=`<div class="concl">${items.map(([h,p,e])=>`<div><h4>${esc(h)}</h4><p>${esc(p)}</p><p class="num-ev">${esc(e)}</p></div>`).join("")}</div>`;
}
function redrawAnalysis(state){
  drawParallax(state);
  drawScatter("skyCanvas",A.ra,A.dec,D.metadata.display_ranges.ra,D.metadata.display_ranges.dec,"right ascension (deg)","declination (deg)",state,{readoutId:"skyReadout",tableId:"skyTable"});
  drawScatter("motionCanvas",A.pmra,A.pmdec,D.metadata.display_ranges.pmra,D.metadata.display_ranges.pmdec,"pmRA (mas yr⁻¹)","pmDec (mas yr⁻¹)",state,{readoutId:"motionReadout",tableId:"motionTable",reference:true});
  drawScatter("cmdCanvas",A.colour,A.g,D.metadata.display_ranges.bp_rp,[D.metadata.display_ranges.g_mag[1],D.metadata.display_ranges.g_mag[0]],"BP−RP (mag)","G magnitude (brighter upward)",state,{readoutId:"cmdReadout",tableId:"cmdTable"});
}
function redrawVisible(){
  const state=VIEW.get();
  if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("design-matrix"))){drawMatrix(state);drawRow(state);drawColumn(state);}
  if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("analysis"))){drawNotebookPca(state);drawControlledPca(state);drawScore(state);drawGroups(state);}
  if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("evaluation")))redrawAnalysis(state);
}
function onShow(i){redrawVisible();}
function renderAll(state){
  if(!D.configurations[state.model][state.config]){VIEW.set({config:DEFAULT_CONFIG[state.model]},{source:"state-normalization"});return;}
  renderHoverBridge(state);renderControls(state);renderDesignTables(state);renderModelStatus(state);renderClusterTable(state);renderSelectedSource(state);buildConclusions(state);redrawVisible();
}

buildProvenance();buildFindings();buildNotebookAudit();buildNotebookTables();buildControls();buildDesignMatrix();buildDefaultComparison();buildExampleTable();buildGlossary();
exampleRows=PC.bindTableRows("#exampleTable",{
  key:row=>Number(row.dataset.key),selected:()=>VIEW.get().selected,
  onSelect:key=>{const row=document.querySelector(`#exampleTable tbody tr[data-key="${key}"]`);VIEW.set({selected:key,example:row?.dataset.example||"custom",hovered:-1},{source:"example-table"});},onClear:()=>VIEW.set({selected:Number(D.examples.center),example:"center",hovered:-1},{source:"example-table"})
});
VIEW.subscribe((state,changed)=>{if(changed.length===1&&changed[0]==="hovered"){renderHoverBridge(state);if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("design-matrix")))drawMatrix(state);return;}renderAll(state);},{immediate:true});

/* §2.4 — the story strip, above the header figure: the card's headline question
   and its three one-sentence panels, with this demo's own painters supplying
   the thumbnails. Rendered only when the card carries a `story` block; a record
   written before the block existed leaves the slot hidden and the page opens
   exactly as it did. renderStory repaints its canvases on every theme change
   through PC.initTheme's own redraw path, so redrawVisible() never has to know
   the strip exists. */


/* §3.2 — the header figure. With PROVENANCE.md's v2 card in the payload it is
   the workflow DAG: the four stage columns headed by RIBBON's own labels and
   numbers, carrying the card's steps and edges. Without one it is the RIBBON
   rollup on its own, which is also what the DAG collapses to under 720px.
   renderDag repaints its edges from --axis on every theme change through
   PC.initTheme's own redraw path, so redrawVisible() never has to know. */


/* §10.6 — Source evidence's card sections, above the measured claims table. Part C of
   the same card fills the footer's two [data-prov] slots. */
if (D.provenance_card) PC.renderProvenance("#provCard", D.provenance_card);


PC.panels.dag.create(document.getElementById("workflowDag"),D.dag.steps,D.dag.options);PC.registerRepaint(redrawVisible);PC.repaint("initial",document);

for(const [target,source] of [['evalModel','modelSelect'],['evalConfig','configSelect']])document.getElementById(target).addEventListener('change',event=>{const el=document.getElementById(source);el.value=event.target.value;el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'))});
document.getElementById('evalCut').addEventListener('change',event=>VIEW.set({threshold:Number(event.target.value)},{source:'evaluation-cut'}));
